usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve time-series performance metrics (CPU, memory, network, disk I/O) for a specific node over a chosen timeframe. The node must be online and reachable; requests against offline nodes may return empty or stale data. The `cf` parameter controls whether data points are averaged (`AVERAGE`) or show peak values (`MAX`) — omitting it lets Proxmox choose a default.

examples.summary: Fetch the last hour of averaged node metrics for pve1

tips: Use `MAX` consolidation function to surface peak spikes that would be smoothed away by AVERAGE — useful for capacity planning.
Longer timeframes (month, year, decade) return fewer data points due to RRD downsampling; granularity decreases as timeframe increases.
Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/nodes/{node}` — a read-only audit token is sufficient; no admin privilege needed.
Returns an array of objects where each object is a timestamp bucket; individual metric keys (cpu, mem, netin, netout, etc.) may be absent if not recorded for that interval.
